description: This file implements the core functionality of the 'git hash-object' command in Git, used to compute and store the hash of objects (like blobs) in the Git object database. It includes functions for hashing files, standard input paths, and handling command-line options.

methods.name: void hash_fd(int fd,const char * type,const char * path,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Calculates the hash ID of a file descriptor's content and outputs the hex representation.

methods.name: void hash_object(const char * path,const char * type,const char * vpath,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Hashes the file at the given path with specified type and path, and writes the object into the database.

methods.name: void hash_stdin_paths(const char * type,int no_filters,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Reads file paths from stdin, unquotes if needed, and hashes each object.

methods.name: int cmd_hash_object(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function that handles argument parsing and dispatches appropriate hashing routines.

ctags.name: cmd_hash_object
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: hash_fd
ctags.pattern: /^static void hash_fd(int fd, const char *type, const char *path, unsigned flags)$/
ctags.signature: (int fd,const char * type,const char * path,unsigned flags)

ctags.name: hash_object
ctags.pattern: /^static void hash_object(const char *path, const char *type, const char *vpath,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * path,const char * type,const char * vpath,unsigned flags)

ctags.name: hash_stdin_paths
ctags.pattern: /^static void hash_stdin_paths(const char *type, int no_filters, unsigned flags)$/
